verdicts.reason: A: the shoe floats off the circle, GROVE sits under its own headline, the body copy is tiny and jammed in, the 'BACK BY DEMAND' chip has bigger text than the 'Find It Near You' CTA so the CTA loses hierarchy, and the tilted FREE DELIVERY badge crowds the bottom-left corner. B: also puts GROVE under the headline and runs the headline and body over the circle; the SUMMER ONLY chip is too small to read, and the CTA is pushed to the bottom-right, smaller than the FREE DELIVERY badge in the middle. Even so, B has clearer top-to-bottom order, more readable body text and more even spacing.
